note: First 2 bytes of fuzz input are read as little-endian uint16 type index; set to 35 (UA_TYPES_NOTIFICATIONMESSAGE) to select a type containing an array of ExtensionObjects.
Remaining bytes after the 2-byte header are passed to UA_decodeBinary for the NotificationMessage type, which contains notificationData array of ExtensionObject.
UA_decodeBinary dispatches to Array_decodeBinary for the notificationData array field; the array length is decoded from the input.

code: for(size_t i = 0; i < length; i++) { ret = decodeBinaryJumpTable[type->typeIndex](&dst[i], type); }
note: Loop decodes each ExtensionObject element; the first element is crafted to trigger the XML encoding failure path.

Decodes the NodeId type identifier for the ExtensionObject; crafted as a STRING NodeId (encoding byte 0x03) with namespaceIndex=0 and a valid string length so NodeId_decodeBinary succeeds and allocates string data.
Decodes the encoding byte; set to 2 (UA_EXTENSIONOBJECT_ENCODED_XML) to enter the XML branch.
The NodeId (with heap-allocated string identifier) is moved into dst->content.encoded.typeId; dst->encoding is set to XML.
Decodes the XML body as a ByteString; crafted with a length field that exceeds remaining input so ByteString_decodeBinary returns an error.
On ByteString decode failure, NodeId_deleteMembers frees the heap-allocated string identifier inside typeId, but dst->encoding remains XML and typeId is not reset.
Array_decodeBinary detects the decode error and calls UA_Array_delete on all elements decoded so far, including the failed XML ExtensionObject.
ExtensionObject_deleteMembers sees encoding==XML and calls UA_NodeId_deleteMembers on typeId again, freeing the already-freed string identifier — heap double-free.
UA_Array_delete iterates over the array and calls type->deleteMembers on each element, reaching ExtensionObject_deleteMembers for the crafted element and triggering the double-free crash.
